SCROBICULUM AND STOMACH. [17] [Cinnb.]
Soreness in stomach, with dizziness and lightness in head, and tightness in temples.
Flatulence of stomach ; with irregularity of stools.
   

ABDOMEN AND LOINS. [19] [Cinnb.]
Griping colic, followed by soft, mushy stools.
Tapeworm.
Syphilitic buboes, indurated, not very sensitive or inflamed ; surrounding glands also swollen.
   

STOOLS AND RECTUM. [20] [Cinnb.]
Irregularity of passages.
Bloody dysentery.
Green, mucous diarrhœa which stains the skin about the anus and scrotum a copper color.
Thin stools with tenesmus.
Nightly painful diarrhœa.
Sensation of formication in anus, as if from a large worm.
Little pimples around anus, with burning and itching.
Protrusion of anus during stool.
   

URINARY ORGANS. [21] [Cinnb.]
Frequent and increased emission of watery urine ; also during night.
Pain, as if from a sore in urethra when urinating ; this pain wakes him up at night.
Albuminuria.
   

MALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [22] [Cinnb.]
Increased sexual desire with violent erections, particularly in evening.
Swelling of penis and twitching in it.
Great redness of urethra with pinching pain.
Pain in urethra on urination.
Violent itching of corona glandis, with profuse secretion of pus.
Small, shining red points on glans penis.
A lentil-sized swelling surrounded by a reddish-yellow circle, on glans penis, near urinary meatus ; several reddish-yellow lentil-shaped discolorations on glans and prepuce.
Redness and swelling of prepuce with painful itching.
Warts on prepuce, frenum and inner surface, bleeding when touched.
Phimosis, with profuse, fetid, dirty, pus-like discharge. θ Secondary syphilis.
Syphilitic phimosis, prepuce terribly swollen, purplish and ulcerated, with fetid, gangrenous odor.
Red, swollen chancres with hard, elevated edges, not sensitive, discharging thin pus.
Indurated or neglected chancres.
Indurated chancre on middle of penis.
Round chancre above corona glandis as large as a pea, surrounded by a red circle ; three red patches on glans penis and prepuce, resembling in color the eruptions of scarlatina.
Gonorrhœa of very long standing, with much pain and soreness during urination ; yellowish-green discharge.
Gonorrhœa on a sycotic basis, or complicated with syphilis.
Blennorhea of glans penis.
Sycotic excrescences.
Indurated testicles.
   

FEMALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [23] [Cinnb.]
A few days before appearance of menses, and during their continuance, tearing pain in forehead, sensation of weakness in eyes, rending in spine, tearing pains and cramps in bowels, with diarrhœa and great prostration.
Leucorrhœa, the discharge of which causes a pressure or labor-like pain in vagina.
   

PREGNANCY. PARTURITION. LACTATION. [24] [Cinnb.]
Shooting across abdomen, either right to left or left to right, during pregnancy.
Long-continued false labor pains, child's head pressed against symphysis pubis with violent tenesmus in anus.
   

VOICE AND LARYNX. TRACHEA AND BRONCHIA. [25] [Cinnb.]
Hoarseness in evening.
Syphilitic laryngeal ulcers, torpid, and associated with tuberculosis.
   

COUGH. [27] [Cinnb.]
Cough from tickling in throat.
   

INNER CHEST AND LUNGS. [28] [Cinnb.]
Dyspnœa with heat.
Chest oppressed, feels contracted ; > by stretching himself.
Oppression of chest awakens after midnight.
Pain running over ensiform cartilage from seventh rib on r. side diagonally through chest to back.
   

HEART, PULSE AND CIRCULATION. [29] [Cinnb.]
Pulse slower in forepart of day, accelerated in evening.
   

OUTER CHEST. [30] [Cinnb.]
Red spots and points on neck and chest, changing to little blotches.
   

NECK AND BACK. [31] [Cinnb.]
The muscles of back part of neck seem as if contracted.
Pain in back of neck shooting to occiput, with stiffness and hard swelling of glands at back of neck.
Aching in small of back as if bruised, with coryza.
Sudden stitches and tearing pains on each side of spine, in back and lumbar region.
Pain all over back down to loins, < on drawing a long breath.
   

UPPER LIMBS. [32] [Cinnb.]
Pain in left shoulder, between clavicle and scapula, interiorly.
Periodical shooting pains in arms.
Pain in upper part of right arm, as if it would break.
Sensation of lameness in right arm.
Numbness of left arm, from elbow to end of little finger.
Sensation as if "cazy-bone" had been struck.
Joints of fingers and knuckles are red and hot.
Œdema of right arm.
